name: Aurora Design Public Company Limited
summary: Aurora Design Public Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, retails gold jewelry, diamond jewelry, and gemstones through its chain and online stores in Thailand. It operates through Trading of Jewelry as Gold Jewelry; Trading of Diamonds, Gems and K-Gold; and Sale with Right Redemption for Gold Jewelry, Diamonds, Gems and K-Gold segments. The company retails modern gold products comprising necklaces, rings, bracelets, earrings, and gold plates; diamond jewelry products consisting of diamond rings, necklaces, earrings, bracelets, and pendants; and design gold products, such as gold amulets, auspicious gold leaves, zodiac pendants, necklaces, bracelets, earrings, and gold handicraft …
